facts_found: Business Silver Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on eligible travel and software purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]
Business Silver Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

For the Business Silver Rewards Card, the 10.0% rate applies only if the merchant processes the transaction under a travel or software-related merchant category; if a merchant sells multiple categories, the charge must be coded under a qualifying category. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]
Silver Rewards Card earns 4.0% cash back on eligible travel and software transactions. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]
Silver Rewards Card earns 1.0% back on purchases outside its top (travel/software) categories. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]

For the Silver Rewards Card, using third-party wallets or processors may alter merchant classification and cause the purchase to miss the 4.0% rate; rewards are based on the merchant's submitted category. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

For the Silver Rewards Card, rewards are calculated after transactions post, not at authorization, and pending earnings may adjust if the merchant updates the transaction or issues a credit. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Silver Rewards Card transactions that typically do not qualify for rewards include gift cards, person-to-person payments, fees, interest, and insurance premiums charged by the bank; returned or refunded purchases have rewards reversed when credits post. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Business Silver Rewards Card cash back is credited to the account at the end of each billing cycle, and merchant category exclusions continue to apply. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Business Silver Rewards Card double cash back promo: new customers earn 2x on all purchases for the first 6 months after account opening (travel/software 10.0% becomes 20.0%, other purchases 1.0% becomes 2.0%); account must be opened between 2024-11-14 and 2025-11-14, and the 6-month window starts on the account opening date. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

All Rho-Bank credit card rewards, including cash back cards such as Silver Rewards Card and Business Silver Rewards Card, are stored in the transaction database as 'points' and convert at 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

All credit card rewards points are rounded down (floored) to the nearest whole number per purchase, not rounded to nearest; this applies consistently across all card types and reward categories. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]
Each Rho-Bank card has its own bonus categories at higher rates, and purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card's default rate. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005]

Silver Rewards Card guidance directs customers to consolidate redemptions once they reach 17 and to plan redemptions around billing cycles so new earnings post and they meet the 17 in a single statement period (unit not stated in the document). [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_008]

Business Silver Rewards Card also offers annual travel credits of up to 50 and a 1.5% foreign transaction fee, which are separate from cash back accrual. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_010]

open_questions: No documented per-period or annual CAP on bonus-category cash back was found for either the Business Silver Rewards Card or the Silver Rewards Card.
The Business Silver Rewards Card's minimum redemption threshold was not found in the knowledge base.
The 'Exceptions and Exclusions' section referenced by the Business Silver Rewards Card promo doc (the full list of non-earning merchant categories/transaction types for that card) was not retrieved.
The unit for the Silver Rewards Card redemption threshold stated as '17' (dollars vs points) is ambiguous in the source document.
Whether the Business Silver double-cash-back promo applies to this specific customer depends on their account opening date, which is not known.

facts_found: submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id: str, transaction_id: str) is the tool the customer runs to report a discrepancy between cash back received and cash back owed for a specific transaction; it applies to all credit card transactions. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

The agent must confirm the customer has the correct transaction_id before submission, must not collect sensitive card details, and should advise that supporting context (category or promotion expectations) may be requested later during review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Rewards corrections are made only after a cash back dispute is resolved and approved; the transaction_id values to fix are found by looking up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The internal agent tool for posting a rewards adjustment is update_transaction_rewards_3847, which must first be unlocked with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then invoked with call_discoverable_agent_tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

update_transaction_rewards_3847 takes transaction_id (exact transaction identifier) and new_rewards_earned (a string formatted as 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The agent must independently recalculate correct rewards per transaction from card type, transaction category, and any applicable promotions, and must NOT rely on the expected_rewards field in the dispute record. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

After calling update_transaction_rewards_3847, the agent must confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history and retain calculation notes in the internal case record for auditability. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Customer-facing missing-cash-back guidance lists qualifying situations (bonus-category purchase that earned only the standard rate, amount lower than calculated, no rewards at all, suspected merchant miscategorization) and states support will verify the merchant category, check applicable reward rates, and determine if an adjustment is needed. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Information helpful for a rewards investigation: transaction date, merchant name and purchase amount, cash back received vs. expected, and receipts/documentation. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id) returns a user's credit card dispute records including dispute_id, dispute_date, status (open, under_review, closed), last_updated_at, transaction_id, merchant, amount, reason_code, outcome and internal notes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

The documented cash back dispute/correction process does not require a human/specialist transfer; the agent performs the recalculation and posts the correction with the internal tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Transfer reason codes for transfer_to_human_agents are a fixed tiered list; the Tier 1 codes that could apply to a rewards/system miscalculation escalation are technical_system_error (system error or outage preventing completion of the request) and complex_billing_dispute (billing disputes requiring specialist review, e.g., statement errors). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

No deadline or filing window for disputing credit card rewards/cash back accrual is stated in the retrieved documentation (the 60-day and other dispute deadlines found apply to transaction/Reg E disputes, not cash back disputes). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Rewards corrections are expressed in points because all credit card rewards (including Silver and Business Silver cash back) are stored as points in the transaction database at 1 point = $0.01. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
Corrected point values must be whole numbers because all credit card rewards points are rounded down (floored) per purchase. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

open_questions: No documented deadline/time limit for filing a cash back (rewards accrual) dispute was found in the KB.
No documented SLA/resolution timeframe for how long a cash back dispute review takes (only generic 'a few days to several weeks' language for transaction disputes, which is a different process).
No dedicated 'rewards calculation case' tool exists in the retrieved docs; the only case mechanism found is the cash_back_disputes record created by submit_cash_back_dispute_0589.

No documented policy on whether over-credited points are clawed back/reversed versus left in place, or whether a separate dispute type is used for over-credits (doc_003 covers 'discrepancy between cash back received and cash back that should have received' for all transactions).
Whether multiple affected transactions require one dispute per transaction_id (implied by the tool signature but not stated explicitly).

facts_found: Rewards corrections are applied only after a cash back dispute is resolved and approved; the agent identifies transactions to fix by looking up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database to obtain the transaction_id values. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The knowledge base does not name a specific tool or signature for querying the cash_back_disputes database; doc_004 only instructs the agent to 'look up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

get_user_dispute_history_7291 returns only credit card transaction dispute records (dispute_id, dispute_date, status open/under_review/closed, transaction_id, merchant, amount, reason_code, outcome, notes) and is not documented as a cash_back_disputes lookup. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

For get_user_dispute_history_7291, an empty result set means the user has not filed credit card disputes or the user_id is incorrect; the agent should confirm the correct user_id and retry, and escalate through internal support channels only for persistent partial/truncated data. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

The agent must independently recalculate correct rewards from card type, transaction category, and applicable promotions and must NOT rely on the expected_rewards field in the dispute record. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The internal rewards adjustment tool is update_transaction_rewards_3847, which must first be unlocked with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then invoked with call_discoverable_agent_tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

After calling update_transaction_rewards_3847 the agent must confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history and retain calculation notes in the internal case record for auditability. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id, transaction_id) is run by the customer to report a cash back discrepancy for a specific credit card transaction; the agent confirms the correct transaction_id, does not collect sensitive card details, and advises that supporting context may be requested later during review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Tier 1 transfer reason codes that could apply to a rewards/system miscalculation escalation are technical_system_error (system error or outage preventing completion of the request) and complex_billing_dispute (billing disputes requiring specialist review). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

All credit card rewards, including cash back cards, are stored as points in the transaction database at 1 point = $0.01, so corrections are expressed in points. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
All credit card rewards points are rounded down (floored) per purchase, so corrected point values must be whole numbers. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

Customer-facing missing-cash-back guidance says support will verify the merchant category, check applicable reward rates, and determine if an adjustment is needed; useful inputs are transaction date, merchant name and amount, cash back received vs. expected, and receipts. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

No explicit playbook is documented for the case where a customer reports an approval notification but no matching approved record exists in cash_back_disputes (e.g. whether to have the customer resubmit, wait for sync, or escalate); the recommendation to withhold the correction is derived from the stated precondition that corrections occur only after a dispute is resolved and approved.

No documented review/resolution timeline or notification-latency window for cash back disputes was found, so it cannot be confirmed whether the customer's approval notice may simply be ahead of the internal record.

facts_found: Silver Rewards Card transactions that typically do not qualify for rewards include gift cards, person-to-person payments, fees, interest, and insurance premiums charged by the bank; returned or refunded purchases have rewards reversed when credits post. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Business Silver Rewards Card cash back is credited to the account at the end of each billing cycle, and merchant category exclusions continue to apply. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Business Silver Rewards Card double cash back promo: new customers earn 2x on all purchases for the first 6 months after account opening (travel/software 10.0% becomes 20.0%, other purchases 1.0% becomes 2.0%); account must be opened between 2024-11-14 and 2025-11-14, and the 6-month window starts on the account opening date. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

All Rho-Bank credit card rewards, including cash back cards such as Silver Rewards Card and Business Silver Rewards Card, are stored in the transaction database as 'points' and convert at 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

All credit card rewards points are rounded down (floored) to the nearest whole number per purchase, not rounded to nearest; this applies consistently across all card types and reward categories. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]
Each Rho-Bank card has its own bonus categories at higher rates, and purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card's default rate. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_005]

Silver Rewards Card guidance directs customers to consolidate redemptions once they reach 17 and to plan redemptions around billing cycles so new earnings post and they meet the 17 in a single statement period (unit not stated in the document). [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_008]

Business Silver Rewards Card also offers annual travel credits of up to 50 and a 1.5% foreign transaction fee, which are separate from cash back accrual. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_010]

submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id: str, transaction_id: str) is the tool the customer runs to report a discrepancy between cash back received and cash back owed for a specific transaction; it applies to all credit card transactions. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

The agent must confirm the customer has the correct transaction_id before submission, must not collect sensitive card details, and should advise that supporting context (category or promotion expectations) may be requested later during review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Rewards corrections are made only after a cash back dispute is resolved and approved; the transaction_id values to fix are found by looking up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The internal agent tool for posting a rewards adjustment is update_transaction_rewards_3847, which must first be unlocked with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then invoked with call_discoverable_agent_tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

update_transaction_rewards_3847 takes transaction_id (exact transaction identifier) and new_rewards_earned (a string formatted as 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The agent must independently recalculate correct rewards per transaction from card type, transaction category, and any applicable promotions, and must NOT rely on the expected_rewards field in the dispute record. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

After calling update_transaction_rewards_3847, the agent must confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history and retain calculation notes in the internal case record for auditability. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Customer-facing missing-cash-back guidance lists qualifying situations (bonus-category purchase that earned only the standard rate, amount lower than calculated, no rewards at all, suspected merchant miscategorization) and states support will verify the merchant category, check applicable reward rates, and determine if an adjustment is needed. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Information helpful for a rewards investigation: transaction date, merchant name and purchase amount, cash back received vs. expected, and receipts/documentation. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id) returns a user's credit card dispute records including dispute_id, dispute_date, status (open, under_review, closed), last_updated_at, transaction_id, merchant, amount, reason_code, outcome and internal notes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

The documented cash back dispute/correction process does not require a human/specialist transfer; the agent performs the recalculation and posts the correction with the internal tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Transfer reason codes for transfer_to_human_agents are a fixed tiered list; the Tier 1 codes that could apply to a rewards/system miscalculation escalation are technical_system_error (system error or outage preventing completion of the request) and complex_billing_dispute (billing disputes requiring specialist review, e.g., statement errors). [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

No deadline or filing window for disputing credit card rewards/cash back accrual is stated in the retrieved documentation (the 60-day and other dispute deadlines found apply to transaction/Reg E disputes, not cash back disputes). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]
